commentary.text: 90+8' Mateo Busquets is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+6' Angel Ortiz (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+4' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+4' Vitor Roque (Betis) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Diego Llorente (Betis) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Shots on target – 6:5.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
89' Substitution. Hugo Sotelo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jailson (Celta Vigo).
87' 3 - 2 Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) finds some space just outside the penalty area after getting on the end of a sweet pass and blasts the ball into the goal!
87' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.
85' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
82' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) replacing Oscar Mingueza.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Duran leaves the pitch and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes on.
82' Vitor Roque (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
79' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

76' This was a piece of cake for Adrian. Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
74' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
72' Here is a change. Antony is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
72' The substitution is prepared. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jesus Rodriguez.
72' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
71' A cross by Johnny Cardoso (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
69' The attendance for today's match is 22651.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antony (Betis) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' 2 - 2 Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!
63' 1 - 2 An excellent first touch by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
62' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
62' Isco (Betis) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isco (Betis) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' A wild pass somehow finds Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
60' Isco (Betis) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) for Alfonso Gonzalez.
60' Substitution. Iker Losada makes way for Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).

59' Antony (Betis) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Vicente Guaita, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
58' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Marc Roca is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cedric Bakambu walks off the pitch to be replaced by Vitor Roque (Betis).
57' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' The ball possession at the moment is 59:41.

50' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
50' Antony (Betis) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets blows for a foul. Celta Vigo get a free kick.
48' Celta Vigo hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' Half-time substitution. Manuel Pellegrini decided to make a change. Romain Perraud is replaced by Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.

45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The shots on goal statistics – 3:4.
43' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
43' The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
42' Celta Vigo couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Adrian (Betis) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
41' Angel Ortiz (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
39' A long through ball into the box almost gives Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
37' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Adrian makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
36' Celta Vigo win a corner.
36' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
35' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
34' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
34' A cross into the box from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
34' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but Adrian punches the ball away.
33' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
31' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the bar.
30' CHANCE! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
30' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
29' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
28' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
27' Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
22' 0 - 2 Diego Llorente (Betis) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 0:2.
22' Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
22' Marc Roca (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
20' Vicente Guaita pulls off a fine save! Cedric Bakambu (Betis) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the middle, but the effort is kept out.
20' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Isco (Betis) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Cedric Bakambu.
17' Mateo Busquets blows for a foul after Cedric Bakambu (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
12' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Antony (Betis) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
8' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Romain Perraud (Betis) for his blatant foul.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is adjudged offside.
4' Marc Roca (Betis) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the right side of the goal lacks power and Vicente Guaita easily makes the save.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
2' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
